improvements: Text 2967 -> 2473 lines (165 KB -> 146 KB). All LM:* string reverts in fund, claim, triggerDefault, impairLoan and removeLoanImpairment are decoded (quoted 78 -> 116; raw 'revert with memory' gone). Calls named: poolDelegate, mapleGlobals, mapleTreasury, isBorrower, principal, repossess, borrower. Log payloads decoded (e.g. claim's 0x948106be.. and 0x1e2d80f3.. events). claim's 'if ok: log else revert' flattened to 'if not ok: revert' then the log. Two 'issuanceRate > int256.max' string checks in claim are folded into SafeMath.sub(0x7fff..ff, issuanceRate), whose helper reverts with exactly 'LM:UINT256_OOB_FOR_INT256'. The zero-padding tests after the constant-68 copy loops are dropped (always true). P6 41 -> 0, P2 41 -> 15, return-memory 2 -> 0.
notes: Diff 2290 lines, reviewed function by function. claim's revert count is 27 -> 25: the two removed reverts are the 'LM:UINT256_OOB_FOR_INT256' checks folded into SafeMath.sub (def SafeMath: sub reverts with that string; sub2 is the Panic(17) one, unchanged since round 1), so no revert path is lost. Evaluation order is kept: the helper is the left operand of the 'and'. triggerDefault (two defs) gains only the two dead checks reported. Lines with >= 4 ceil32 terms 59 -> 100 (base pointers substituted), but lines over 240 chars 42 -> 35. No loop in the source; 15 implicit whiles unchanged.
summary: One low regression: triggerDefault prints two never-failing 'x < min(x, y)' Panic(17) checks. Otherwise improved: every LM:* revert decoded, calls and log payloads named, text 17% shorter. ERC20Helper calls are still raw memory behind constant-length copy loops.
